output.title: Parcel API behind a route table
output.description: An invented parcel API: a gateway's route table sends each app request to its service by method and path, and 10% of quotes to a canary. An old app version's requests match no rule and are rejected 404. In Live, each route has its own colour and shape.

simulations.title: A busy afternoon
simulations.description: Forty app requests and thirty carrier events a second for half a minute. Watch each route's colour reach its own service, the old app's requests refused 404 at the gateway, and carrier events queue up.

action.text: Each route has its own colour and shape; the gateway's table sends it to its service.
Requests from the old app match no rule: the gateway rejects them 404.
Carrier events arrive at 30/s; their service takes 20/s, so its backlog grows.

simulations.title: The pricing canary goes down
simulations.description: Five seconds in, the pricing canary stops. The table keeps its 90/10 split, so about one quote in ten still goes to the canary and is lost there: the outage stays visible instead of quietly moving to Pricing.

action.text: The canary is down. Its 10% of quotes still go to it: weights don't move by themselves.

expectations.label: Quotes sent to the down canary are lost
Only the old app is refused
